title: The Release Staircase
prompt: Use Dazzler to design the release staircase for its fictional reader task. A wide four-step production staircase leads from assignments to a separate publication checkpoint; the deadline is a lower closing band. Retain the existing data and functional controls, with keyboard and mobile access. Use Office Code Pro, #9C2A14 and #FFD74A. Preserve factual caveats and local-only behavior; do not imply real booking, payment, publication or account changes.
